arxiv-2206-13162.title: Egeon : Software-Defined Data Protection for Object Storage
arxiv-2206-13162.creator: Raul Saiz-Laudo, Marc Sánchez-Artigas
arxiv-2206-13162.description: Abstract With the growth in popularity of cloud computing, object storage systems (e.g., Amazon S 3 3 , OpenStack Swift, Ceph) have gained momentum for their relatively low per-GB costs and high availability. However, as increasingly more sensitive data is being accrued, the need to natively integrate privacy controls into the storage is growing in relevance.

arxiv-2211-15829.title: Y-cube model and fractal structure of subdimensional particles on hyperbolic lattices
arxiv-2211-15829.creator: Han Yan (闫寒), Kevin Slagle, Andriy H. Nevidomskyy
arxiv-2211-15829.description: Abstract Unlike ordinary topological quantum phases, fracton orders are intimately dependent on the underlying lattice geometry. In this work, we study a generalization of the X-cube model, dubbed the Y-cube model, on lattices embedded in H 2 × S 1 H_{2}\times S^{1} space, i.e., a stack of hyperbolic planes.

arxiv-2301-10172.title: MTTN: Multi-Pair Text to Text Narratives for Prompt Generation Thanks: Citation : Ghosh et al. MTTN: Multi-Pair Text to Text Narratives for Prompt Generation.
arxiv-2301-10172.creator: Archan Ghosh, Debgandhar Ghosh, Madhurima Maji, Suchinta Chanda, Kalporup Goswami
arxiv-2301-10172.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Archan Ghosh, Debgandhar Ghosh, Madhurima Maji, Suchinta Chanda, Kalporup Goswami. The increased interest in diffusion models has opened up opportunities for advancements in generative text modeling. These models can produce impressive images when given a well-crafted prompt, but creating a powerful or meaningful prompt can be hit-or-miss. To address this, we have created a large-scale dataset that is derived and synthesized from real prompts and indexed with popular image-text datasets such as MS-COCO and Flickr.

arxiv-2406-02193.title: Optical polarimetry study of Lambda-Orionis star-forming region
arxiv-2406-02193.creator: Sharma Neha, Archana Soam, G. Maheswar
arxiv-2406-02193.description: Abstract We present an optical polarimetric study of a nearby star-forming region, Lambda-Orionis, to map plane-of-the-sky magnetic field geometry to understand the magnetized evolution of the HII region and associated small molecular clouds. We made multi-wavelength polarization observations of 34 bright stars distributed across the region.

arxiv-2510-24188.title: Investigating Software Aging in LLM-Generated Software Systems
arxiv-2510-24188.creator: César Santos, Ermeson Andrade, Roberto Natella
arxiv-2510-24188.description: Abstract Automatically generated software, especially code produced by Large Language Models (LLMs), is increasingly adopted to accelerate development and reduce manual effort. However, little is known about the long-term reliability of such systems under sustained execution. In this paper, we experimentally investigate the phenomenon of software aging in applications generated by LLM-based tools.

arxiv-2602-21479.title: Global Sequential Testing for Multi-Stream Auditing
arxiv-2602-21479.creator: Beepul Bharti bbharti1@jhu.edu, Ambar Pal ambarpal@amazon.com, Jeremias Sulam jsulam1@jhu.edu
arxiv-2602-21479.description: Abstract Across many risk sensitive areas, it is critical to continuously audit the performance of machine learning systems and detect any unusual behavior quickly. This can be modeled as a sequential hypothesis testing problem with k k incoming streams of data and a global null hypothesis that asserts that the system is working as expected across all k k streams.

pmc-11395025.description: Ficus drupacea is a fruit-bearing tree that is distributed in Southeast Asia and Australia. pmc-12504541.title: Clustering and time series analyses of hybrid immunity to SARS-COV-2 using data from the BQC19 biobank
pmc-12504541.creator: Jean-Frédéric Boulianne, Denis Larocque, Simon Rousseau, Delphine Bosson-Rieutort
pmc-12504541.description: The SARS-CoV-2 pandemic revealed that immunity after infection was temporary, with reinfections occurring. As the pandemic progressed, individuals encountered infection and vaccination in varying sequences and at different time intervals, resulting in heterogeneous patterns of infection, reinfection and vaccination, so-called hybrid immunity.

pmc-13499718.title: Real-World Adult Height Outcomes in Girls with Central Precocious Puberty Receiving GnRHa Monotherapy or Combined with Growth Hormone: A Cohort Study in China
pmc-13499718.creator: Fei Wang, Yan Li, Yu Yang, Wei Gu, Xuan Xu, Haiying Wu, Guimei Li, Xiaoqin Yin, Shasha Zhou, Pin Li
pmc-13499718.description: IntroductionAlthough gonadotropin-releasing hormone analogs (GnRHa) are the standard treatment for central precocious puberty (CPP), the efficacy of GnRHa monotherapy in older children (around 8 years) and that of combination therapy with recombinant human growth hormone (rhGH) both remain unclear. This study aims to evaluate the real-world efficacy of each regimen.MethodsThis retrospective cohort study enrolled Chinese girls with CPP.

uslaw-usc-t42-s13332.title: 42 U.S.C. § 13332 — Coal-fired diesel engines
uslaw-usc-t42-s13332.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s13332.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 134 (Energy Policy); Subchapter VI (Coal); Part A (Research, Development, Demonstration, And Commercial Application). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary shall conduct a program of research, development, demonstration, and commercial application for utilizing coal-derived liquid or gaseous fuels, including ultra-clean coal-water slurries, in diesel engines. The program shall address— (1).
